profile.name: 是德科技 N90xxB X 系列信号分析仪
profile.description: 这是一类台式射频信号/频谱分析仪，用于观察和测量信号的频谱分布、功率电平、带宽、杂散、噪声及相关射频特性。它常用于射频与微波实验、通信信号测试、器件表征和频谱扫频测量，并支持分辨率带宽、视频带宽、检波器、输入衰减、参考电平、轨迹读取及部分 IQ 采集相关功能。
profile.description_en: This is a benchtop RF signal/spectrum analyzer used to view and measure signal spectra, power levels, bandwidth, spurs, noise, and related RF characteristics. It is commonly used in RF and microwave labs for communication signal testing, device characterization, and swept spectrum measurements, with support for resolution bandwidth, video bandwidth, detector selection, input attenuation, reference level control, trace readout, and some IQ capture-related functions.
